title: Hunter
subtitle: Everyone Get to Cover!
text:
When Played: Choose two. You may choose the same option more than once:
Give a Shield token to a unit.
Attack with a unit, even if it's exhausted. It can't attack bases for this attack.
rules:
You can wait to see how your first option resolves before choosing your second option.
If you choose the second option of Hunter's "When Played" ability, you must attack with a unit, if able.
Units that can’t attack bases can still damage bases through other abilities, like Overwhelm.
